audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does _prepare_trie correctly identify Account values and route them through encode_node with storage roots?
audit_items.skip_details: Property references Python-style functions (_prepare_trie, isinstance(value, Account), encode_node, get_storage_root) that do not exist in the go-ethereum codebase. This property is written for a Python-based Ethereum EL implementation (e.g., py-evm or execution-specs), not the Go implementation (geth). Target codebase is go-ethereum which uses different naming conventions and patterns.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does root(S) produce identical Merkle roots as other correct Ethereum MPT implementations for the same state S?
audit_items.skip_details: Property references a root(S) function from Python-based Ethereum implementation. While go-ethereum does implement Merkle Patricia Tries, the specific function signatures and patterns referenced (like _prepare_trie) are from Python EL implementation. The verification test procedure references Python-specific patterns not applicable to Go codebase.

audit_items.title: Does patricialize create LeafNodes with the correct rest_of_key (key[level:]) without off-by-one errors?
audit_items.skip_details: Property references 'patricialize' function which is a Python-style function name from Python-based Ethereum implementation. Go-ethereum uses different functions (newLeaf, stacktrie operations) with different patterns. The key[level:] Python slice syntax and test procedure are specific to Python implementation, not applicable to Go codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does _prepare_trie correctly convert preimage keys to Address type for get_storage_root calls?
audit_items.skip_details: Property references _prepare_trie function and Address(preimage) Python-style conversion that do not exist in go-ethereum. The test procedure references Python patterns (Address type constructor) not used in Go implementation. Go-ethereum handles address conversion differently through common.Address type.
